svg.title: Regional waveform maps and visual-cortex waveform phenotypes
svg.desc: A shows the enlarged visual-cortex mean waveforms first, on the left. B shows all six independently fitted regional maps, including visual cortex. C-E extend the visual-cortex map with the unchanged FS, optotagged SST, and overlap labels. All panels share one plotting canvas and one typography scale.
